proof_body:
by
  intro G _ H K
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨L, hL⟩
    have hmem : ∀ x : G, x ∈ L ↔ ∃ h ∈ H, ∃ k ∈ K, x = h * k := fun x => by
      have : x ∈ (L : Set G) ↔ x ∈ {x : G | ∃ h ∈ H, ∃ k ∈ K, x = h * k} := by rw [hL]
      exact this
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨h, hh, k, hk, rfl⟩
      have hx : h * k ∈ L := (hmem _).2 ⟨h, hh, k, hk, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨h', hh', k', hk', he⟩ := (hmem _).1 (L.inv_mem hx)
      refine ⟨k'⁻¹, K.inv_mem hk', h'⁻¹, H.inv_mem hh', ?_⟩
      rw [← mul_inv_rev, ← he, inv_inv]
    · rintro ⟨k, hk, h, hh, rfl⟩
      have hkL : k ∈ L := (hmem _).2 ⟨1, H.one_mem, k, hk, by simp⟩
      have hhL : h ∈ L := (hmem _).2 ⟨h, hh, 1, K.one_mem, by simp⟩
      exact (hmem _).1 (L.mul_mem hkL hhL)
  · intro hcomm
    have hswap : ∀ k ∈ K, ∀ h ∈ H, ∃ h' ∈ H, ∃ k' ∈ K, k * h = h' * k' := by
      intro k hk h hh
      have : k * h ∈ {x : G | ∃ k ∈ K, ∃ h ∈ H, x = k * h} := ⟨k, hk, h, hh, rfl⟩
      rw [← hcomm] at this
      exact this
    refine ⟨{ carrier := {x : G | ∃ h ∈ H, ∃ k ∈ K, x = h * k}
              mul_mem' := ?_
              one_mem' := ⟨1, H.one_mem, 1, K.one_mem, by simp⟩
              inv_mem' := ?_ }, rfl⟩
    · rintro _ _ ⟨h₁, hh₁, k₁, hk₁, rfl⟩ ⟨h₂, hh₂, k₂, hk₂, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨h₃, hh₃, k₃, hk₃, he⟩ := hswap k₁ hk₁ h₂ hh₂
      refine ⟨h₁ * h₃, H.mul_mem hh₁ hh₃, k₃ * k₂, K.mul_mem hk₃ hk₂, ?_⟩
      calc h₁ * k₁ * (h₂ * k₂) = h₁ * (k₁ * h₂) * k₂ := by group
        _ = h₁ * (h₃ * k₃) * k₂ := by rw [he]
        _ = h₁ * h₃ * (k₃ * k₂) := by group
    · rintro _ ⟨h, hh, k, hk, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨h', hh', k', hk', he⟩ := hswap k⁻¹ (K.inv_mem hk) h⁻¹ (H.inv_mem hh)
      exact ⟨h', hh', k', hk', by rw [mul_inv_rev, he]⟩
target_source: ∀ (G : Type*) [Group G] (H K : Subgroup G), (∃ L : Subgroup G, (L : Set G) = {x : G | ∃ h ∈ H, ∃ k ∈ K, x = h * k}) ↔ {x : G | ∃ h ∈ H, ∃ k ∈ K, x = h * k} = {x : G | ∃ k ∈ K, ∃ h ∈ H, x = k * h}
